description: List the connected social media accounts available to this API key. Each account includes its accountId (use when targeting a specific account in create_post), platform, username/displayName, brandId/brandName (workspace — for dashboard-connected accounts this is the dashboard workspace the account is assigned to; group accounts by it, but do NOT pass a dashboard brandId to create_post), and connection health (isConnected false + needsReconnect true = the token is dead; tell the user to reconnect that account in the Schedulala dashboard instead of posting to it). There is no separate brands endpoint — read brand ids from here.

brandId.description: Filter to one workspace / brand id.

name: list_accounts
title: List Accounts
